name: find-call
description: (beta) Universal /find-call skill — pull deep, cited context from your past Google Calendar meetings. Reads the notes-bot "Meeting Resources" block (Transcription, Meeting Notes, Video, Parent Folder) plus optional transcripts (Sembly or any connected notetaker) in parallel, spawns sonnet sub-agents per matched call for transcript-depth, and resolves teammate names against the shared ~/.claude/shared/identity.json roster (same file /clickup and /gevent use). Uses whatever calendar/doc/transcript tools are available by default — set a preferred provider per source with /find-call:config (always with fallback, so data is retrieved by any working method) and inspect resolution with /find-call:status. Investigation is read-only — never modifies Calendar, Drive, or transcripts.
